title: P4.9 — grouped batch authority, parity and qualification
text:
Implemented internal Authorizer::decideMany() and tuple resolve() through the existing PanelResolver; scalar conflicting panel is rejected. BatchEvaluation shares scalar stages, one captured now and result order, batch-local subject/actor/scope-owner snapshots, guarded native per-witness UNION queries and external allowsMany with actual role/contribution fields. ReadAttempt shares source sessions/state and reads deduplicated scope chunks <=100 behind one group fence, reloads whole attempts, reuses raw cache and publishes after observations only from the accepted set. BeforeDeny/PolicyOnly retain code state with no assignment dependency; unconfirmed dynamic/changing groups return ConsistencyError with code state. Independent source/subject/tenant/mode groups fail separately; cross-group storage/panel revision conflict retries three times then denies only affected storage groups. Exact visibility/public wrappers remain later owners.

Acceptance: V1 initial101 batch+CRM tests/25961 assertions; final24 batch tests/3386 assertions including one added cross-group scenario (102 distinct batch+CRM cases combined). V6 affected768 core tests/135619 assertions; architecture72/314; new SQL batch suite3/1562 per real PG16.14/MySQL8.4.10/MariaDB10.11.19, azguard_test at loopback25432/23306/23307. SQL barriers acknowledge independent-process revoke after chunk1; complete reread or fail-closed after three; no discarded after observations. Seeded scalar parity200 batches; V45 full ordered IDs1000resources; R58 full10000clients/100scopes/multirole scalar equality. Cold250contexts:2 panel_state reads, grants<=6; Check warm1 state/0 assignments; Request warm0/0 then new request1/0. CRM structural SQL bounds<=4ceil(contexts/100) project queries, users<=2, Client queries0, bind parameters<=1000; live membership SQL accounted separately <=resource count. R68 mixed PolicyOnly/DB Grants/relation-only across two panels retains codec-framed typed state map/order/one now. R58 list/total/EXPLAIN remains P4.23 and public/consumer surfaces P5/P6/P8; README keeps partial status.

Final changed PHP Pint, core PHPStan0 errors, API generator/check, diff check GREEN. Fresh serial no-cache type report99.64%, all209 eligible rows of212 source PHP files; three existing plugin-excluded traits named in types.json inventory. Optional PHPStan turbo startup warning retained; actual analysis succeeds. Behavioral V1/V2/V3/V4/V5/V6 evidence preceded only BatchEvaluation type-array-shape/empty-retry guards corrections; final24 batch tests verifies affected path; final V7/V8/V9/V10 separate. No unchanged Filament, ecosystem, Redis/replica/broad unrelated engine suites rerun.

Raw RED probes preserved: fixture missing Grant/filtering/PolicyBinding, boundary TenantMismatch overwritten (owning repair), native witness exception mapping, stale dynamic Prepare/unconfirmed StateToken (owning retry/discard), PHPStan array shapes, late regression import ordering. Interrupted native review before verdict exit130 is not a completed round; all checks accepted before the final full native review. Evidence: artifacts/P4.9-execution/checks.json, product-files.json, final-candidate-files.json, V*.json/log, batch-final.log and types.json. Native Grok4.7/high verdict GREEN, session 12c56425-8c58-4f74-b0fa-e9ed0e1a24b1, one completed review round, no context parameter. Full candidate scope supplied; reviewer inspected source/diff/norms and selected tests but explicitly did not inspect DecideManyParityTest, V1–V10 log bodies, AfterStage, remaining AuthorityStage or CRM filter classes. Our executed checks substantiate those validation results independently. Long native navigation stopped and same session resumed for finalization; candidate hashes remained unchanged. Read-only transport/coverage attestation and exact verdict: review-verdict.json/md. Owner JSON-layout migration and unrelated dirty tree preserved.

Finish registration: Task CLI --evidence rejected both existing local and absolute proof paths as outside repository/plan; defect recorded in finish-evidence-path-defect.json and log. Explicit V1–V10 exit checks registered, raw evidence retained; no acceptance check failed.
